scope: Post-v0.13 browser focus event sequencing; no engine, desktop or released-tag changes
fix: A monotonic event epoch invalidates older asynchronous focus refreshes after any newer focus/blur. State refresh is retained for reconnect handling.

regression.input: Hold one POST and the older focus state refresh using one Playwright route interceptor; enqueue a later blur, release state then POST. Verify focus=false reaches the controller and Start is rejected while unfocused. Restore focus, complete ten rounds and required-choice save/resume.
regression.released_baseline: FAIL: no focus=false POST reaches controller within the controlled ordering timeout
regression.fixed_browser: PASS: both busy-blur and delayed-focus→blur tests, ten rounds and pending-choice continuation
regression.fixture_input: Real browser events/HTTP response ordering only; no game-state mutation or injected private state
regression.limits: Synthetic window events exercise event handlers and controller guard, not physical operating-system window-manager focus transitions.
